title: Destocking with a working capital swing, distributor inventories back to normal and reorders started

input.facts: Hematology analyzers with reagents and service; recurring revenue is 58% of sales. Reagent orders fell as distributors cut their inventory, and the share price dropped 35%. The company's own inventory and receivables rose sharply over the period, a working capital swing that reduced operating cash flow. Distributor inventory levels are now back to normal and reorders have started. Leverage 1.9x. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: leading indicator for a potential window of actionability
